lQu-5iNul8z5h5Up_56VCQ.zh: 孟加拉西北部朗布爾專區某衛生中心截至今年9/24,收治37例疑症狀患者。該疫情與屠宰病牛後,牛肉分送約100戶食用有關,且牛肉檢體已驗出陽性菌,部分病例曾參與屠宰或處理牛肉。當局已啟動疫情調查,並持續推動受影響地區疫苗接種,以降低傳播風險。 尚比亞疫情更新,東北部穆欽加省截至今年9/21累計報告21例確定病例,病情穩定,另有59頭野生動物死亡。當局已啟動大規模家畜疫苗接種,並呼籲⺠眾勿食用野生動物肉品,以降低人畜共通傳播風險。
lQu-5iNul8z5h5Up_56VCQ.en: As of 24 September this year, a health centre in Rangpur division in north-western Bangladesh had admitted 37 suspected cases. The outbreak is linked to the slaughter of sick cattle, after which the beef was distributed to about 100 households for consumption; beef samples tested positive for the bacterium, and some cases had taken part in slaughtering or handling the beef. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and continue to promote vaccination in affected areas to reduce the risk of transmission. Zambia update: Muchinga Province in the north-east has reported 21 confirmed cases as of 21 September this year; cases are stable, and 59 wild animals have died. Authorities have launched large-scale livestock vaccination and urge people not to eat wildlife meat, to reduce the risk of transmission between animals and humans.

TdykG3EA33FC2dl-P1a4wg.zh: 尚比亞東北部姆欽加省(Muchinga Province)三個縣近期爆發疑疫情,已造成約40頭動物異常暴斃,並有11名個案出現疑症狀,目前尚無死亡案例。由於炭疽芽孢可⻑期存活於土壤,且偏遠農村檢測與醫療資源有限,當局已派員啟動現場調查,以防堵疫情擴大,並呼籲居⺠勿食用、處理或販售暴斃動物之肉品。該國2023年曾爆發全國性(9個省份)大流行,累計684例疑病例及4例死亡;2011年亦曾發生因接觸死河馬肉,導致逾500人感染之重大疫情事件。
TdykG3EA33FC2dl-P1a4wg.en: Several suspected outbreaks have recently occurred in three districts of Muchinga Province in north-eastern Zambia, causing abnormal deaths of about 40 animals and 11 people with suspected symptoms; no deaths have been reported so far. Because anthrax spores can survive in soil for long periods, and detection and medical resources in remote rural areas are limited, authorities have dispatched staff to conduct field investigations to prevent the outbreak from spreading, and urge residents not to eat, handle or sell meat from animals that died suddenly. In 2023, the country experienced a nationwide epidemic across nine provinces, with 684 cumulative suspected cases and 4 deaths; in 2011, contact with dead hippopotamus meat caused a major outbreak that infected more than 500 people.

SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.zh: 安哥拉疫情持續且嚴峻,自今年初截至3/23累計16省報告8,543例病例,其中329例死亡(CFR:3.9%),約30%死亡數發生在社區,2月單週病例逾1,000例,達高峰後下降,惟於近期單週再達1,200例高峰。病患分布於盧安達省為多,本戈省次之,多為6-14歲族群(佔21.7%)。WHO表示當地公衛介入措施不足、延遲通報、當地雨季加劇傳播風險,且位處交通要道並與鄰國尚比亞及剛果民主共和國接壤,評估該國和鄰國傳播風險為非常高。另今年迄3/23累計3區署24國報告9 3,172例病例,其中1,197例死亡。
ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.en: Angola's outbreak continues and is severe. From the start of the year to 23 March, 8,543 cases and 329 deaths (CFR: 3.9%) were reported from 16 provinces, and about 30% of deaths occurred in the community. Weekly cases exceeded 1,000 in February and then declined after peaking, but recently reached a new weekly peak of 1,200. Most cases are in Luanda Province, followed by Benguela Province; most patients are aged 6–14 years (21.7%). WHO notes insufficient local public health interventions, delayed reporting and rainy-season conditions that increase transmission risk. The country sits on major transport routes and borders Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO assesses the transmission risk for Angola and its neighbours as very high. Also, from the start of the year to 23 March, 24 countries across 3 WHO regions reported 93,172 cases, of which 1,197 were deaths.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).
